mermaid.title: 憲法・6柱・利用者価値・14条項
mermaid.source:
flowchart TD
  constitution[Product Constitution]
  constitution --> NGP_P01[利用者価値]
  NGP_P01 --> outcome_NGP_P01[意思決定・提案・設計・顧客対話に使える]
  constitution --> NGP_P02[完全な公開体験]
  NGP_P02 --> outcome_NGP_P02[記事、Web、音声、Podcast、通知が一体で届く]
  constitution --> NGP_P03[人手なしの日次運用]
  NGP_P03 --> outcome_NGP_P03[生成から次回準備まで自然実行だけで閉じる]
  constitution --> NGP_P04[壊さない・信頼できる運用]
  NGP_P04 --> outcome_NGP_P04[公開Greenと正しいruntime authorityを守る]
  constitution --> NGP_P05[持続可能な作業]
  NGP_P05 --> outcome_NGP_P05[人間負担・手戻り・総期待資源を抑える]
  constitution --> NGP_P06[物理提出と説明責任]
  NGP_P06 --> outcome_NGP_P06[利用可能状態と監査証拠を残す]
  outcome_NGP_P01 --> NGC_C01[利用者の業務価値へ接続する]
  outcome_NGP_P01 --> NGC_C02[編集・出典・鮮度・関連性品質を守る]
  outcome_NGP_P02 --> NGC_C03[必須公開bundleの部分完了を認めない]
  outcome_NGP_P03 --> NGC_C04[日次全工程を人手なしで閉じる]
  outcome_NGP_P03 --> NGC_C05[repair-firstで同日公開成果を守る]
  outcome_NGP_P04 --> NGC_C06[危険・secret・破壊・public regressionをfail-closedにする]
  outcome_NGP_P04 --> NGC_C07[scheduled/recovery/public/readiness/audit/externalを分離する]
  outcome_NGP_P05 --> NGC_C08[checkpointと因果retryで再生成を防ぐ]
  outcome_NGP_P04 --> NGC_C09[immutable generationとsingle writerを守る]
  outcome_NGP_P04 --> NGC_C10[登録済み復旧だけを実行する]
  outcome_NGP_P05 --> NGC_C11[noFocusTheft・noAutoOpen・noMonitoring・即時停止を守る]
  outcome_NGP_P05 --> NGC_C12[Sol/Luna/local toolをentropyに応じて配置する]
  outcome_NGP_P06 --> NGC_C13[commit/push/install/runtime/task/rollbackを閉じる]
  outcome_NGP_P06 --> NGC_C14[全active仕様を憲法へ結び、憲法改変をユーザーだけに限定する]
